name: Remember
source:
A story about a Grandma and her delusion of thoughts.

Her thoughts played her.

Take a careful decision with choices that you want to take. In the end your choice will bring her back to her family or send her to the nursing house.

[From [url=https://sky-drake-studio.itch.io/remember]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于奶奶和她的思想错觉的故事。

她的思想在玩弄她。

对你想要做出的选择做出仔细的决定。最终你的选择是将她带回家人身边还是送她去疗养院。

[来自[url=https://sky-drake-studio.itch.io/remember]Itch.io[/url]]
